_comment: Hand-curated tier overlay. NEEDS USER REVIEW before this is treated as final -- weights and inclusion/exclusion are product taste, not derived from data. Merged on top of the Fortune 500 base by scripts/build_reference_data.js: an override always wins over a Fortune-500-rank-derived weight for the same normalized company name. 'dream' foundation reused from the existing Registry Seeder / ExpandQuery.md cohort list (34 companies), re-tiered into a continuous 0-1 weight instead of a flat flag, plus additions for quant trading firms and 2024-2026-era AI startups the original flat list didn't cover.

private_fortune500_supplement._comment: Forbes Global 2000 is public-companies-only; these are large PRIVATE US companies that rank in Fortune 500 by revenue but would otherwise be invisible to a public-company-only base list.
